goal:
New crate contracts/toilet-staking. Spec: docs/economy/2026-11-02-toilet-round-spec.md §S (S1-S8). Owner decisions T5, T7 and T9.

OWNERSHIP (owner decision T9, 2 Nov)
- No owner, no upgrade, no pause, no admin method of any kind (spec S8). new() runs once. The README states the deploy procedure: deploy, initialise, delete the full-access key, record the transaction.

WHY
The board already splits mPOO 10 / 20 / 70 and holds the stakers' 70% in a locked reserve until set_staking_contract is called, once, ever. Nothing can receive it. This contract stakes TOILET, releases at most 10% of its mPOO pool per day to stakers pro rata, and burns 10% of every unstaked amount.

SCOPE
- S1-S7 exactly as specified: stakes, pool, MasterChef accumulator with a compile-time-checked scale, release(now) with whole days by repeated /10 (bounded loop) and a proportional partial day, sync_inflow (the board pays with a plain ft_transfer, so inflow is counted from the contract's own mPOO balance), ft_on_transfer for stake (TOILET, msg stake) and fund (mPOO, msg fund), unstake with the exit tax burned by ft_transfer to the 64-zero burn address (the burn route recorded in docs/handover-2026-10-29.md on 2 Nov; the burn address must be registered on the TOILET token), claim_rewards, NEP-145 storage, views and events.
- ops/keeper: call sync_inflow after a successful distribute_mpoo, behind a config flag that defaults off until a staking contract is configured. Keep the keeper's existing tests green and add one.

ACCEPTANCE
- Every test in spec §S tests, plus a workspace simulation with the real board and token wasm: distribute_mpoo -> sync_inflow -> time passes -> two stakers claim and unstake with exact amounts asserted.
- cargo test --locked green for all crates; release wasm; clippy clean.
- contracts/toilet-staking/README.md: the drip in plain numbers (it smooths payouts and does not grow them), the exit tax, the inflow path, the failure paths, and the one-time set_staking_contract consequence.
- docs/learning entry with the boundaries.

DO NOT
- Do not change contracts/paid-board or contracts/toilet. If the contract cannot be built against them as they are, stop and report.
- Do not deploy, and never call set_staking_contract on any board. That call is the owner's, after review.
- Do not edit docs/backlog.md.
